newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria offer forklift maker Balkancar for sale.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria offer forklift maker Balkancar for sale.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet on Friday approved the sale of state-owned Balkancar Holding, a major forklift truck producer, a government spokeswoman said.
"The government approved a proposal for the sell-off of Balkancar Holding, submitted by the Privatisation Agency," Lyubov Vidinska told reporters after the weekly cabinet session.
She declined to give details about potential buyers and their offers.
Local media said that Elite, a big Russian industrial group, has shown interest in buying 100 percent of Blakancar. Elite's representatives met recently with senior Bulgarian government officials.
Balkancar was one of 70 companies slated for isolation from credits as part of an enterprise restructuring plan agreed six months ago with multilateral lenders.
Balkancar's debts to banks and suppliers amount to $29 million and 6.3 billion levs, local media said.

The cabinet postponed approving next year's privatisation programme until its next session on January 9. Privatisation proceeds are expected to be a major source of revenue for the debt-ridden country.
